title: Exactly what I need!
body: Easy to use app, I’ve tried many habit tracking apps but this is the best. It has everything that an app would need to have. Even without premium you can do a lot of things in there!! Great job
author: Kostas paraskeuo

title: Great start, full of potential
body:
I love Today. 
Fantastic design and well thought implementation.

A great start, full of potential to become a must have app.
author: Yiannis Konstantakopoulos

title: Lovely
body: Love the UI and the features
author: skoussouris

title: A little push to start forming good habits!
body: Motivates you to set goals and achieve them. Easy and fun to use, and with the in-app purchase it becomes really customizable to your needs.
author: HarrisR.
